0.text: People want to come in but your park is closed. You should think about opening up.

1.text: Lots of your visitors are thirsty. Maybe you should build some more drinks shops?

132.text: Lots of visitors are buying balloons. This is a good indication that they're really happy.

160.text: Some of the customers at your shops aren't happy with the quality of the merchandise. You need to make improvements before more people get mad.

170.text: Customers at your shops feel like they've had a good deal. You're a marketing genius! Congratulations!

161.text: Some customers are unhappy with the quality at your restaurants. You need to make improvements or more people will get angry.

172.text: Visitors are very happy with the drinks they've bought in your park. Keep up the good work!

163.text: Some of the visitors who tried your sideshows aren't happy. You should try to find out what went wrong.

173.text: Good news! People who've played your sideshows don't feel cheated.

146.text: Your staff are exhausted and are working poorly. I think you should build them a staff room, or risk a strike.

147.text: Don't you think it's about time you hired some staff?

123.text: Your guards are well trained. Any trouble caused in your park gets dealt with quickly and efficiently.

124.text: Your researchers are among the best in the world. Training them has really paid off.

3.text: Your rides are starting to wear out but you don't have any mechanics. You should think about hiring some.

6.text: You've no cleaners and the park is starting to get untidy. Maybe you should hire some?

7.text: You've no cleaners and the park is very untidy. You should hire some!

18.text: Your cleaners could do a better job if you set their patrol areas.

19.text: Some areas of your park don't have a cleaner patrolling them.

56.text: Your selection of rides isn't so good. You should build some more.

69.text: A park of this size should have more shops in it. Maybe you should build some more.

92.text: You could spend some of your accumulated wealth to improve your park.

93.text: Staff wages are higher than your income. You need to do something about this - perhaps you could get rid of the most expensive employees?

151.text: Your bank balance is looking pretty low! I think you need to curb your spending before you end up in the red.

152.text: Your bank balance isn't looking very healthy! I think you need to cut down on spending, and possibly take out a loan, before you end up in the red.
